meta.name: prd-development
meta.description: Build a structured PRD that connects problem, users, solution, and success criteria. Use when turning discovery notes into an engineering-ready document for a major initiative.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将调研笔记转化为工程师就绪的产品需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将产品想法系统化为可执行的PRD。
copy.tagline_en: Turn discovery notes into engineering-ready PRDs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to structure product ideas into actionable PRD documents.

howto.what: 引导你通过8个阶段（问题陈述、用户画像、战略背景、解决方案、成功指标、用户故事等）一步步创建结构化的产品需求文档（PRD）。Claude会提问并帮你填充标准模板。
howto.when: 当你需要将调研笔记整理成可供工程团队执行的产品需求文档时触发，例如开始一个新功能或产品项目、对齐跨职能团队时。

say.text: 帮我为电商平台的新AI推荐功能写一份PRD。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成8个阶段，逐步生成完整文档。

say.text: 我刚完成一个探索冲刺，现在需要把结果转成工程师能用的PRD。
say.note: Claude会从问题陈述开始，帮你整理发现。

howto.what_en: Guides you through 8 phases (problem statement, personas, strategic context, solution overview, success metrics, user stories, etc.) to build a structured Product Requirements Document (PRD). Claude will ask questions and help fill a standard template.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to turn discovery notes into an engineering-ready PRD for a major initiative, such as starting a new feature or product, aligning cross-functional teams, or documenting decisions.

say_en.text: Help me write a PRD for a new AI-powered recommendation feature in our e-commerce platform.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through all 8 phases to generate the full document.

say_en.text: I just finished a discovery sprint and need to turn the findings into a PRD my engineers can act on.
say_en.note: Claude will start with the problem statement and help structure your insights.
